name: What kind of kitchen floor gives the best long-term result?

mainEntity.name: What kind of kitchen floor gives the best long-term result?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best outcome is a floor that is level, durable, easy to clean, and suited to how you use the kitchen. In many homes, tile, vinyl, and engineered wood are considered because they balance appearance, moisture resistance, and maintenance needs differently.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best floor is level, durable, easy to clean, and matched to how your kitchen gets used. Tile, vinyl, and engineered wood are common options because they balance appearance and moisture resistance differently.
